image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white ceramic bowl containing fresh figs. One whole green fig with purple/brown speckling is visible in the upper left. In the foreground, a halved fig reveals its pink/amber interior and seeds. To the right, there are pieces of what appears to be white flower petals or possibly onion skin, along with a small dark stem-like object. The lighting is soft and diffuse.
